#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;

    std::string underScore;
    std::string bracket;

    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        if (s[i] == '(') {
            i++;
            while (s[i] != ')') {
                bracket += s[i];
                i++;
            }
            i++;
            bracket += '_';
            underScore += '_';
        } else {
            underScore += s[i];
            i++;
        }
    }

    underScore += '_';
    bracket += '_';

    int max = 0;
    std::string token;
    std::istringstream underStream(underScore);
    while (std::getline(underStream, token, '_')) {
        if (!token.empty()) {
            max = std::max(max, (int)token.length());
        }
    }

    int max2 = 0;
    std::istringstream bracketStream(bracket);
    while (std::getline(bracketStream, token, '_')) {
        if (!token.empty()) {
            max2++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << max << " " << max2 << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
